preamble: Gk and L in the clues refer to similar beings.

clue.text: L to point to an act

parts.note: S is south, one of the compass points
taken as written
a turn is an act in a variety show

explanation.surface: Someone is told to point to a particular act on the programme.
explanation.walkthrough: Per the preamble, L stands for a Latin (Roman) god. The point S is added to A TURN.
explanation.definitionFit: Saturn is a Roman deity, god of sowing and of the Golden Age.

clue.text: Celebrity backed by doctor with mild expletives

indicators.note: the whole string is read backwards

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor
drats are gentle curses

explanation.surface: A famous person is supported by a doctor who swears only mildly.
explanation.definitionFit: Stardom is the state of being a celebrity.

clue.text: Treat — cooked (four?) fish

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are worked up into something new

explanation.surface: A treat of cooked fish, perhaps four of them.
explanation.walkthrough: '(four?)' is a hint: tetra- is the Greek prefix for four.
explanation.definitionFit: A tetra is a small brightly coloured tropical freshwater fish.

clue.text: Engineering unit, one certain to check surveyor's calculations

parts.note: REME is the British Army's Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers
A means one
sure means certain

explanation.surface: An army engineering unit is sure to verify a surveyor's figures.
explanation.definitionFit: To remeasure is to measure again, a way of checking calculations.

clue.text: L's sacking constricts relation, a radical

definitions.note: read as 'L is', the Roman god being defined

indicators.note: the sacking fabric squeezes in the next piece, holding it inside

parts.note: jute is the coarse fibre that sacking is woven from
pi is the fixed ratio, or relation, of a circle's circumference to its diameter
R is the chemists' symbol for a radical

explanation.surface: A political radical is held down by a relative, like a sack tied round them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'L's' means 'L is', so the definition is the Roman god. 'constricts' gives JUPITE before R is added; 'relation' rests on pi being a ratio.
explanation.definitionFit: Jupiter is the chief god of the Roman pantheon, king of the gods.

clue.text: Mary's father takes the part of John, a tailless ape

indicators.note: only a portion of the name is used

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the final letter of the ape is removed

parts.note: a chimp is an ape

explanation.surface: Someone playing Mary's father takes the role of John, an ape without a tail.
explanation.walkthrough: JO is the opening part of John. Tradition names Joachim as father of the Virgin Mary.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Joachim is traditionally the father of the Virgin Mary.

clue.text: Gk submarine supplier

definitions.meaning: a Greek god of the underworld, also called Plouton
the wartime pipeline laid under the Channel to supply fuel

explanation.definitionFit: Pluto names the underworld god and PLUTO, Pipe-Line Under The Ocean, of 1944.

clue.text: "Summertime, and ___" — vicar's got a sinecure!

definitions.meaning: the opening line of the Gershwin song from Porgy and Bess
a living is a clergyman's benefice; here it is an undemanding job

explanation.definitionFit: The Gershwin lyric continues with these words, and a living is a church benefice.

clue.text: Means of going straight to the right milk supply

parts.note: a cow's udder supplies milk

explanation.surface: A way to go straight to the right milk source on a dairy farm.
explanation.definitionFit: A rudder steers a boat, keeping it on a straight course.

clue.text: See 6
Gk one has a source of absinthe

parts.note: per the preamble a Greek deity: Artemis, goddess of the hunt
the Roman numeral I is one
taken as written

explanation.surface: A Greek figure possesses where absinthe comes from.
explanation.definitionFit: Artemisia is the wormwood genus, the bitter herb that flavours absinthe.

clue.text: Put top to bottom and head to tail to be hung in Paris

indicators.note: the letter at one end of the French word is carried round to the other end

parts.note: pendu is French for hung or hanged

explanation.surface: Instructions for turning something over, then hanging it up in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: Strictly, moving the answer's head to its tail gives PENDU; read the other way, PENDU's last letter goes to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: To upend something is to turn it upside down, putting its top at the bottom.

clue.text: US state not in L

indicators.note: the word in is to be left out of the state's name

parts.note: Indiana is a state of the American Midwest
taken as written

explanation.surface: An American state lies outside some territory called L.
explanation.definitionFit: Diana is the Roman goddess of the hunt and the moon.

clue.text: Gk 24 has one Romano drinking hot tea endlessly

parts.note: A means one, as in a single thing

indicators.note: the politician takes in the next letter, swallowing it

parts.note: Romano Prodi, the former Italian prime minister
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

indicators.note: the final letter of the drink is dropped

parts.note: taken as written before the cut

explanation.surface: An Italian called Romano is seen drinking hot tea without end.
explanation.walkthrough: Gk 24 is the Greek counterpart of 24 across, the Roman goddess of love. 'Romano' leads to Romano Prodi, who takes in H; TE is tea less its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of love, matching Venus in the Roman pantheon.

clue.text: L travelling in the tube?

definitions.meaning: a Roman god, the messenger of the gods
the liquid metal that moves up and down a thermometer's tube

explanation.definitionFit: Mercury is both the Roman messenger god and the silvery metal in thermometers.

clue.text: Slightly preferable to skin problem outside the smallest state

indicators.note: the skin complaint goes round the next pieces

parts.note: a rash is a skin eruption
taken as written
RI is Rhode Island, the smallest US state

explanation.surface: Something preferable to a skin complaint around the smallest country.
explanation.definitionFit: Ratherish means somewhat rather, so only slightly preferable.

clue.text: A thousand people opposed to prayer?

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
antis are people who are against something

explanation.surface: A large crowd turns out to protest against prayer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prayer' is read as one who prays: the insect holds its forelegs as if in prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: The praying mantis is named for its forelegs folded as if in devotion.

clue.text: Pole (wood, very badly executed initially) for US city

parts.note: N is the North Pole
ash is a tree and its timber
ill means badly

indicators.note: just the first letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A Pole, made of wood, was very badly executed at first in a US city.
explanation.definitionFit: Nashville is the capital of Tennessee, home of country music.

clue.text: Gk article subsequently repeated

parts.note: A is the indefinite article
then means afterwards, subsequently
the article A is given a second time

explanation.surface: A Greek article is published and then published again.
explanation.definitionFit: Athena is the Greek goddess of wisdom, patron of Athens.

clue.text: Sick men are incontinent, which doesn't happen to elephants

indicators.note: together with the in hidden in the next word, the scrambled men are inside the continent

parts.note: read as in continent: the continent is Asia

indicators.note: being sick suggests the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: Ill men are unable to control themselves, unlike elephants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'incontinent' splits as 'in continent', so the word is doing the containing; 'Sick' jumbles the men. Elephants proverbially never forget.
explanation.definitionFit: Amnesia is loss of memory, and elephants proverbially never forget.

clue.text: With a face like a guru in a recording

indicators.note: the wise man sits inside the recording

parts.note: vid is short for video, a recording
a sage is a wise teacher, like a guru

explanation.surface: Someone looks like a guru caught on video.
explanation.definitionFit: Visaged means having a face of a stated kind, as in grim-visaged.

clue.text: L shows love, commonly got up, has the ability to follow

indicators.note: in a down entry the word is raised, read bottom to top

parts.note: luv is the common, colloquial spelling of love
can means is able

explanation.surface: A Roman god shows love in a common way, and can keep up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'got up' suits a down entry, read upwards; 'to follow' only places the ability after the reversed love.
explanation.definitionFit: Vulcan is the Roman god of fire and the forge.

clue.text: Push a girl's girl

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, so the possessive gives Di's
miss is a girl

explanation.surface: Push a girl's own girl around.
explanation.definitionFit: To give someone the push is to dismiss them from a job.

clue.text: Further words to solvers about church by Gk (eventually) loved by …

parts.note: PS is a postscript, words added after

indicators.note: the plural you goes round the church

parts.note: ye is the old plural you, addressing solvers

explanation.surface: Further words to solvers about church, from a Greek in love.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue runs on into 23 down: Psyche was loved by Cupid and was eventually made a goddess.
explanation.definitionFit: Psyche was the mortal loved by Cupid, eventually made immortal.

clue.text: Back Gk 4 across to preserve (with alcohol) "A Passage to India"

indicators.note: the Greek god's name is read from end to start

parts.note: the Greek counterpart of Jupiter is Zeus
to can food is to preserve it in tins
AL is short for alcohol

explanation.surface: Pickling a Greek god in spirits recalls the E. M. Forster novel.
explanation.walkthrough: Gk 4 across is the Greek equivalent of 4 across, the king of the gods.
explanation.definitionFit: The canal gave ships a shorter route to India, punning on Forster's novel title.

clue.text: … detectives holding top L

indicators.note: the detectives hold the next piece inside them

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, British police detectives
up means at the top

explanation.surface: Detectives are holding a top Roman.
explanation.definitionFit: Cupid is the Roman god of love.

clue.text: L from heaven, usquebaugh

indicators.note: the letters are taken out of the run of words that follow

explanation.surface: A Roman god sent from heaven brings whisky.
explanation.walkthrough: Usquebaugh is an old Gaelic word for whisky.
explanation.definitionFit: Venus is the Roman goddess of love.

clue.text: The back of the chest? On the contrary, the stomach

parts.note: no is a reply contradicting
tum is a colloquial word for stomach

explanation.surface: Asked whether something is the back of the chest, the reply is no, it's the stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: The notum is the back surface of an insect's thorax, its chest.

clue.text: Call of French politician to make one's hair curl?

parts.note: cri is French for a cry or call
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: The speech of a French politician is shocking enough to make one's hair curl.
explanation.definitionFit: To crimp hair is to press it into small waves or curls.

clue.text: California artist turned composer

indicators.note: the letters are rearranged, turned into something else

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A Californian painter changed careers and became a composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Domenico Scarlatti was an Italian baroque composer of keyboard sonatas.

clue.text: Chained, sadly, being without teeth

indicators.note: something going sadly wrong suggests these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A chained creature has sadly had its teeth pulled.
explanation.definitionFit: The echidna, a spiny anteater, is a creature with no teeth.

clue.text: Gk 13 from another mess

indicators.note: the letters are taken out of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A Greek god emerges from another mess.
explanation.walkthrough: Gk 13 is the Greek counterpart of 13 across, the messenger god.
explanation.definitionFit: Hermes is the Greek messenger of the gods, matching the Roman Mercury.
